items.title: Tommy Ridgley Interview, 1986-06-20
items.q: I am the only person that Miss Walker gave a tape to.

ctx.x: This is, I think it's spreading a lot. Spreading a lot. Okay, yeah.

Okay, I did this with Eddie Bo again. Eddie Bo talked me into putting up some money, because he actually talked me into this. But anyway, I put up quite a bit of money and came up with this label, and come to find out, you listen to this, huh? Yeah, I've heard it. Okay, come find out, Eddie Bo had recorded this on Walter Washington. And recorded Spreading Life? Yeah, on Walter Washington. And I didn't know it, and since he couldn't do nothing with it on Walter Washington, and he recognized it as a pretty good…
Now. Yeah. So, that track on Rizway, the same as the track on the Doudrop label?
